overview: Prospective observational study of all colorectal resections from January 2027 to December 2028, recording bundle elements on a two-minute form in theatre and surgical site infection by active 30-day surveillance with a day-30 phone call.
population: All adults having elective or emergency colorectal resection at the hospital; no exclusions except patients who die within 48 hours.
exposure: Full compliance: every applicable bundle element delivered, scored all-or-none over applicable elements using written applicability rules (for example, bowel preparation does not apply to emergency cases). Element-level delivery is recorded for description.
procedures: The circulating nurse and anaesthetist complete the form at the end of surgery, including end-of-surgery temperature and the latest glucose. Surveillance nurses review inpatients and call every patient at day 30, with up to three attempts and a clinic check for those not reached. Covariates (emergency status, contamination class, stoma, diabetes, body mass index 35 or more, operation over 180 minutes) come from the operation note.

outcomes.name: Surgical site infection within 30 days
outcomes.why: What patients experience and the working group wants to reduce.

outcomes.name: Full and element-level compliance
outcomes.measure: Proportion of cases with each element and with all applicable elements delivered
outcomes.why: The first question the working group asked.

outcomes.name: Completeness of post-discharge follow-up
outcomes.measure: Proportion of patients reached at day 30
outcomes.why: Almost half of infections appear after discharge.

feasibility: About 760 resections over 24 months; the form takes under two minutes; the day-30 call is existing practice.
biasMitigation: Compliance recorded at the time of surgery
Applicability rules written before data collection
Adjustment for emergency status and contamination
Outcome assessors not told compliance status

biasFlags.label: Loss to post-discharge follow-up
biasFlags.note: Three call attempts and a clinic check.

biasFlags.label: Recording changes behaviour
biasFlags.note: Compliance may rise because it is recorded; described in the 12-month report.

flags: Six covariates fixed before data collection
parsimony.simplestPath: One exposure, one primary outcome, six covariates.

theoreticalFramework: No framework beyond the observational design.
summary: Twenty-four-month prospective study with a two-minute form and complete 30-day surveillance.
